Strategy: Pair items only when the item is big. When twice the item covers the largest residual, aim for a leftover of one item; for small items tightness alone decides. Score by distance from a leftover of one item when big, by Best Fit otherwise, exact fits tied at the top, so ranking switches from Best Fit only for big items. It may help by pairing when the item dominates, but may fail by ignoring pairing for small items.

```python
def priority(item, bins):
    return [(-(abs(r - item - item)) + (item if r - item == 0 else 0) if item * 2 >= max(bins) else -(r - item)) for r in bins]
```
generator_note: Size-conditional pairing: pairing target when item*2 >= max(bins), else Best Fit.
